# R2AI2026 TRUY HỒI TÀI LIỆU Y KHOA ĐA NGÔN NGỮ — Competition Brief

- Slug: `r2ai2026-vibiomir` | Host: Codabench | Competition id: 15
- URL: https://leaderboard.aiguru.com.vn/competitions/15/ (tab: #/pages-tab)
- Description: R2AI2026 TRUY HỒI TÀI LIỆU Y KHOA ĐA NGÔN NGỮ - Shared Task 3
- Participants: 72 | Submissions: 762 | Created: 2026-09-30T15:34:45.636301Z
- Organizer: AI Guru – Công ty Cổ phần Tập đoàn Dagoras Group, Tầng 8, số 80 Duy Tân, Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội
- Contacts: Nguyễn Thị Minh Nguyệt (0981544974, nguyetntm@dagoras.io); Vũ Thị Thuỳ Linh (0961891198, linhvtt@dagoras.io)
- Docker image: codalab/codalab-legacy:py37 | Execution time limit: 600s | Robot submissions: False

## Task

Vietnamese biomedical queries -> retrieve relevant **documents** AND relevant **chunks**
from a multilingual (vi/en/zh) corpus that each team builds itself by crawling the URLs in
`links_corpus.parquet`. Organizers provide NO embedding/indexing pipeline.

## Timeline (all deadlines 23:59 ICT / UTC+07:00)

| Milestone | Date |
|---|---|
| Public test released | 2026-10-01 |
| Public phase (API) | 2026-09-30T00:00:00Z -> 2026-10-31T00:00:00Z (name: Kiểm thử công khai) |
| Public submission deadline | 2026-10-31 23:59 ICT |
| Private phase (API) | 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-11-04T00:00:00Z (name: Kiểm thử riêng) |
| Final system deadline | 2026-11-04 23:59 ICT |
| Results announced | 2026-11-11 |

## Data (HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AIGuruTinix/ViBioMIR)

- `query.parquet`: `id:int`, `query:str` — Vietnamese medical queries. **1,200 queries total** across both phases; system must answer ALL; platform splits public/private automatically.
- `links_corpus.parquet`: `id:int`, `url:str` — source article URLs. Teams crawl, preprocess, chunk and index themselves.
- Ground-truth doc labels use the integer `id` in `links_corpus.parquet`; docs outside the list are never positive.
- HF files: .gitattributes, README.md, figures/01_query_length_distribution.png, figures/04_medical_topic_signals.png, figures/05_intent_distribution_pie.png, figures/AI Guru.jpg, figures/MedKB.png, figures/records_by_year_without_books.png, figures/tokens_by_category_without_books.png, links_corpus.parquet, query.parquet
- HF tags: task_categories:text-retrieval, multilinguality:multilingual, language:vi, language:en, language:zh, size_categories:1M<n<10M, format:parquet, modality:text, library:datasets, library:pandas, library:polars, library:mlcroissant, region:us, medical, information-retrieval, vietnamese, english, chinese

## Metric

- Document level: Precision = |D∩G|/|D|, Recall = |D∩G|/|G|
- Chunk level: chunk c is correct if overlap(c,g) = LCS_tokens(c,g)/|g| >= **0.40** against ANY reference
  chunk of the same question+doc_id. Text normalized: Unicode NFKC, HTML entities decoded,
  lowercased, whitespace collapsed/trimmed.
- F2 = 5·P·R / (4·P + R), macro-averaged per query.
- **FINAL_SCORE = mean(DOCS_F2MACRO, CHUNKS_F2MACRO); per-query Precision/Recall/F2 macro-averaged over all queries, scored separately at document level and chunk level**
- Leaderboard columns: FINAL_SCORE, DOCS_F2MACRO, CHUNKS_F2MACRO, DOCS_PRECISION, DOCS_RECALL, CHUNKS_PRECISION, CHUNKS_RECALL

## Submission format

Single `.json` file (JSON array), then ZIP it (ONLY the json inside, no subfolder) and upload
via **My Submissions** on https://leaderboard.aiguru.com.vn:

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "relevant_docs": ["<doc id>"],
    "relevant_chunks": [
      {"doc_id": "<doc id>", "chunk_text": "<verbatim text extracted from the document>"}
    ]
  }
]
```

- `id`: integer query id. `relevant_docs`: predicted doc ids (integer `id` field of `links_corpus.parquet`).
- `relevant_chunks[].chunk_text` MUST be verbatim extracted from the source document (no rewriting/generation).
- Optional `chunk_order`: non-negative int; default = position in the array.
- Empty lists required if no prediction at a level. Missing questions/files => submission not evaluated
  (and it does not count against the quota).

## Submission quotas

- Public phase: **10 submissions/day** per team (max 310 per person total).
- Private phase: **5 per day / 5 TOTAL per user** — choose private submissions carefully.
- Final result official only after a working-notes paper is submitted.

## Model / data constraints

- External data allowed **with explicit citation** of sources.
- Open-weight models only (model and/or training data public, e.g. Hugging Face).
- **No closed LLMs** (GPT-4o, Gemini, ...).
- Models released **before 2026-08-01 (ICT)**, size **<= 15B parameters**.

Baseline `BM25 Baseline` (admin): FINAL 0.3764 = DOCS_F2 0.5587 + CHUNKS_F2 0.1941; DOCS P/R 0.8805/0.5146; CHUNKS P/R 0.3403/0.1755.

Multilingual (vi/en/zh) biomedical IR: for each Vietnamese query return relevant doc ids (links_corpus.parquet integer id) and verbatim relevant chunks (LCS-token overlap >= 0.40 counts as correct). Team builds corpus/chunks/index itself; no organizer pipeline. 1,200 queries answered in one submission; platform splits public/private.

Rule constraints shape the approach: models <= 15B released before 2026-08-01, open weights only. Candidate families from plan: deberta-v3, tfidf-linear, sentence-transformer-reranker. Baseline reference is BM25 (FINAL 0.3764), suggesting dense multilingual embeddings (e.g. BGE-m3 / multilingual-e5 class) + chunk-level reranking headroom.
Leaderboard baseline `BM25 Baseline` (admin) on public phase. FINAL_SCORE = mean(docs F2, chunks F2).
